title: Does good corporate governance matter in corporate tax avoidance? A case of Chinese stock market
core_idea: Investigate the relationship between corporate governance and tax avoidance in manufacturing firms listed on the Chinese stock exchange by measuring tax avoidance with an avoidance tax rate proxy, identifying governance indicators via interviews with CEOs/top management, and analyzing a purposive sample of companies using dynamic panel analysis.
tldr: The study aims to assess how corporate governance relates to corporate tax avoidance in Chinese manufacturing firms by combining qualitative identification of governance indicators with a quantitative dynamic panel analysis of a purposive sample.
